h: Nollywood actor claims the late Francis Duru was poisoned, stirring debate
p: A popular actor has alleged that veteran Francis Duru was poisoned, a claim that has divided Nigerians online. No evidence has been made public to support the allegation, and the family has not confirmed it. Many fans have urged caution while mourning the actor.
more: Nollywood colleagues have paid tributes since his death.
Some fans have asked for the claim to be backed with evidence.
